text: The PPCR in PNG is characterized by its programmatic and regional approach, integrating climate resilience into national development planning and infrastructure projects. It involves a layered financing structure with significant contributions from the CIF and the Government of Australia. The initiative emphasizes vulnerability assessments, adaptation planning, and climate-proofing critical infrastructure, such as ports and roads. It also focuses on building capacities at various levels, from communities to government agencies, to effectively plan and respond to climate impacts.

metadata.solution_name: Climate Investment Funds – Pilot Program for Climate Resilience (PPCR) in Papua New Guinea
